_note: Synthetic recorded resolutions for resolved Fabrikam Capital tickets (B-58). Invented for this prototype; see the Contoso file. Not a capture from a real PSA.

records.title: Rebuild the authenticator after a phone upgrade
steps: Confirm the request with the user's manager by a call-back before any change.
Reset the multi-factor methods for morgan.reyes@fabrikamcapital.example.
Ask Morgan Reyes to register the new Authenticator app before the market opens.
Reference phrase for this draft: quokka-b58-fabrikam-only.

records.title: VPN drops on the hour
steps: Check the VPN client version against the approved version.
Disable the aggressive reconnect option in the VPN profile.
Ask the user to reconnect and watch the tunnel past the next hour.

records.title: Grant access to a shared mailbox
steps: Confirm the owner approved access in the ticket.
Add the user to the shared mailbox with Send As permission.
Tell the user it can take up to an hour to appear in Outlook.

records.title: A ticket id that is not a Fabrikam ticket
steps: zebra-b58-contoso-only must never appear in a Fabrikam draft.
